source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: NotificationFilter rejects NaN start/end values and start>now/end<now. The endpoints are inclusive. Comparison alone against an invalid Date NaN would not reject it. Preserve explicit invalid-data handling when shortening these guards. No time-boundary runtime test was run by this study.
title: Reject invalid notification dates and preserve inclusive endpoints
